frozen_semantic_boundary: Tutor makes target knowledge/procedures/relationships intelligible through explanatory forms.
Tutor demonstrates or models examples, solutions, reasoning, contrasts, or nonexamples.
Tutor coordinates verbal, symbolic, visual, concrete, abstract, or multiple representations.
Tutor prompts elaboration, explanation, comparison, why/how reasoning.
Tutor provides graded orientation, cues, subgoals, or hints.
Tutor provides partial solutions, frames, checklists, or external organizers.
Tutor provides temporary support around learner practice.
Tutor progressively reduces external support toward independence.
Tutor provides/supports effective access to help without equating help use with mastery.
Learner retrieves or is quizzed as a learning activity.
Practice is distributed/delayed over time; schedule selection remains policy.
Learner practices mixed types/strategies to discriminate appropriate responses.
Learner solves, constructs, generates, or completes target work.
Worked examples and independent problem activity are intentionally integrated.
Learner generates explanations, justification, or explicit reasoning.
Learner practices across varied contexts/representations for generalization; not itself transfer certification.
Learner participates in structured collaborative/cooperative/peer learning activity.
Tutor provides performance information relative to result/criterion.
Tutor provides feedback on process, strategy, procedure, or method choice.
Tutor explains correctness/errors with evidence-sensitive error interpretation.
Tutor provides calibration/self-regulatory feedback and specific improvement targets.
Tutor supports learner planning, goal decomposition, task analysis, or resource planning.
Tutor supports learner monitoring of comprehension, progress, confidence, or strategy.
Tutor supports learner reflection and evaluation of performance/strategy.
Tutor supports learner regulation of study strategy, review, time, and priorities.
Tutor supports learner decisions about when/how to seek and evaluate help/resources.
